items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: There was a woman called A Bee Palmer. These were great singers.

ctx.x: And she looked at me and said, 'Get out of the way, you little bugger.'

So, and then there was a woman there called Mabel -- what was her name, Mabel, I can't think of it -- and then we had the great Mattie HITE, was there. There was a woman called A Bee Palmer. These were great singers. These were all great singers.
